## Equations
### EQC001 — Calibrated Bose-Hubbard chain Hamiltonian

*Defines every exact-dynamics target and its calibrated couplings.*

$$
H=\sum_{j=1}^{L-1}J_j(a_j^\dagger a_{j+1}+a_{j+1}^\dagger a_j)+\sum_{j=1}^{L}\frac{U_j}{2}n_j(n_j-1)+\sum_{j=1}^{L}h_j n_j
$$

status: `verified` · source: main_equation: Eq. 1; supplement_equation: Eq. S24; supplement_table: Table S1

Numerical form:

```
Use J/2pi=[12.1,12.2,12.3,12.4,12.5,12.6,12.6,12.6,12.6,12.5,12.4] MHz and U/2pi=[-246,-204,-246,-200,-248,-196,-248,-196,-246,-214,-244,-200] MHz. Set equal h_j to zero in a fixed-N sector.
```

Code: `src/quantum_walk.py:build_hamiltonian`, `config/paper_exact.json`


### EQC002 — Fixed-particle occupation-basis matrix elements

*Turns EQC001 into exact finite matrices without a full tensor-product Hilbert space.*

$$
a_j|\ldots,n_j,\ldots\rangle=\sqrt{n_j}|\ldots,n_j-1,\ldots\rangle;\quad a_j^\dagger|\ldots,n_j,\ldots\rangle=\sqrt{n_j+1}|\ldots,n_j+1,\ldots\rangle
$$

status: `reconstructed` · derived from: `EQC001` · source: supplement_section: Numerical simulation; standard_identity: bosonic ladder operators

Numerical form:

```
Enumerate occupation tuples with fixed total N and optional per-site cap; add J_j*sqrt(n_j*(n_{j+1}+1)) for j to j+1 and its reverse.
```

Code: `src/quantum_walk.py:occupation_basis`, `src/quantum_walk.py:build_hamiltonian`


### EQC003 — Coherent short-time evolution

*Advances every initial Fock state on the paper time grid.*

$$
|\psi(t)\rangle=e^{-iHt}|\psi(0)\rangle
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC001`, `EQC002` · source: supplement_section: Numerical simulation; decoherence neglected because the evolution time is much shorter …

Numerical form:

```
Diagonalize the Hermitian matrix once and evaluate eigenphases for all requested times.
```

Code: `src/quantum_walk.py:evolve_state`


### EQC004 — Site density and one-site entropy

*Produces the one-photon density and entropy panels.*

$$
p_j(t)=\langle n_j\rangle;\quad S_j=-\mathrm{Tr}[\rho_j\ln\rho_j]
$$

status: `reconstructed` · derived from: `EQC003` · source: main_text: Fig. 2 information spreading; supplement_figure: Figs. S14-S17

Numerical form:

```
Compute occupations as probability-weighted basis values; use the binary entropy with 0*log(0)=0 for N=1.
```

Code: `src/quantum_walk.py:site_density`, `src/quantum_walk.py:one_particle_entropy`


### EQC005 — Connected z correlation and one-photon concurrence

*Produces the correlation and entanglement-spreading views of the one-photon wavefunction.*

$$
C^z_{ij}=\langle\sigma_i^z\sigma_j^z\rangle-\langle\sigma_i^z\rangle\langle\sigma_j^z\rangle;\quad \mathcal C_{ij}=2|c_i c_j|\;(N=1)
$$

status: `reconstructed` · derived from: `EQC003`, `EQC004` · source: main_equation: Eq. 2; supplement_equation: Eqs. S25-S27

Numerical form:

```
For i!=j compute -4*p_i*p_j and 2*abs(c_i*c_j); diagonal connected variance is 4*p_i*(1-p_i).
```

Code: `src/quantum_walk.py:connected_z_correlation`, `src/quantum_walk.py:one_particle_concurrence`


### EQC006 — Dispersion envelope and group velocity

*Connects the ballistic density front to the reported information-propagation speed.*

$$
k_n=n\pi/(L+1);\quad v_g^{\max}=\max_n |(\omega_{k_{n+1}}-\omega_{k_n})/(\pi/(L+1))|=153.99343\;\mathrm{sites}/\mu\mathrm{s}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC001`, `EQC004` · source: supplement_equation: Eqs. S28-S30; supplement_figure: Fig. S12


### EQC007 — Two-particle correlator and double occupancy

*Produces two-photon correlation matrices and verifies suppression of double occupancy.*

$$
G_{ij}=\langle a_i^\dagger a_j^\dagger a_i a_j\rangle;\quad G_{ii}=\langle n_i(n_i-1)\rangle
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC002`, `EQC003` · source: main_equation: Eq. 3; supplement_figure: Fig. S8

Numerical form:

```
Average n_i*n_j over basis probabilities off diagonal and n_i*(n_i-1) on diagonal; double-occupancy probability at i is P(n_i=2)=G_ii/2.
```

Code: `src/quantum_walk.py:two_particle_correlator`, `src/quantum_walk.py:double_occupancy_probability`


### EQC008 — Hard-core boson comparator

*Tests the paper's fermionization interpretation against an explicit occupancy-constrained limit.*

$$
|U/J|\rightarrow\infty\;\Rightarrow\;n_j\in\{0,1\}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC001`, `EQC002` · source: main_text: hard-core-boson/free-fermion interpretation of Figs. 3-4; supplement_section: Numerical simulation

Numerical form:

```
Build the N=2 basis with max occupation one and the same hopping couplings; verify it equals the projected full-boson hopping Hamiltonian, then compare normalized off-diagonal G matrices with the calibrated-U run and U=0 run.
```

### EQC009 — Disordered on-site potentials and detuning-renormalized hopping

*Defines the 50-realization one- and two-photon disorder ensembles plotted in Figs. S9 and S10.*

$$
h_j=\bar h+\delta h_j,\quad \delta h_j\in[-W/2,W/2],\quad J_{j,j+1}(\Delta)=\frac{J_{j,j+1}^2}{\sqrt{J_{j,j+1}^2+\Delta_{j,j+1}^2}},\quad \Delta_{j,j+1}=h_{j+1}-h_j
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC001`, `EQC002`, `EQC003` · source: supplement_section: Sec. IV.C, effect of unbalanced qubit frequencies; supplement_figure: Figs. S9-S10

Numerical form:

```
For each printed W, independently sample 50 on-site vectors from the printed uniform interval, compute every effective bond from the printed formula, evolve the Table S1 Hamiltonian, and average site densities. A deterministic seed is selected independently as a reproducibility representative; source pixels are not used to select it.
```

Code: `src/quantum_walk.py`, `scripts/run_paper_exact.py`, `config/paper_exact.json`
